stem.text: The graph shows the effect of substrate concentration on the initial rate of an enzyme-catalysed reaction. The enzyme concentration is constant.

stem.alt: Graph with axes labelled initial rate of reaction and substrate concentration, with points R, S and T marked on a curve.

stem.text: Which statement about the graph is correct?

A.text: Between R and S the number of enzyme molecules is limiting the rate of reaction.

B.text: Between R and S the number of product molecules is limiting the rate of reaction.

C.text: Between S and T the number of enzyme molecules is limiting the rate of reaction.

D.text: Between S and T the number of substrate molecules is limiting the rate of reaction.
